sections.title: Attention
sections.sql: select project,name,reason from attention order by project,reason

sections.title: Tasks
sections.sql: select p.name project,t.name,t.owner,t.due_date from tasks t join projects p on p.id=t.project_id where not t.done order by t.due_date

sections.title: Outstanding
sections.sql: select project,room,name,supplier,reference,expected_date,quantity,received_quantity,status from procurement where status<>'received' order by expected_date
